personality_one_liner: A premium, structured, and highly readable quick-commerce experience where products are the hero, elevated by fresh mint green and bright sunshine yellow accents.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass on bottom tab bar
Use glass on featured hero cards overlay sitting on backdrop
dont's: Never blur form fields, body text, or entire screens
Never use on low-end android devices (fallback to solid surfaceSecondary)

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Displays quick-commerce modules with high-quality visual hierarchy.

states.error: Failed to load feed. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Come In' logo and free-text Location selector (glass overlay). Large persistent search bar. Promotional hero banner. Horizontal scroll for Grocery categories and Quick delivery. Vertical lists for Popular products and Home Services. Feature card for 'Request Anything'.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Robust search interface for instant product discovery.

states.empty: Illustration + 'What are you looking for today?'

screens.layout: Sticky search input at top. Recent searches chips. Grid of results with immediate Add to Cart steppers.

screens.name: Categories
screens.purpose: Grid-based exploration of all grocery and home service categories.
screens.layout: 2-column or 3-column grid layout for visually rich category tiles. Each tile should have a tinted background or a clear image.

screens.name: ProductListing
screens.purpose: Vertical list of products under a category.
screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row has a clear image, title, price, and a quantity stepper (+/-) button. Do NOT show fulfilling shop name.

screens.name: ProductDetails
screens.purpose: Immersive product view with clear pricing and quantity.
screens.layout: Large hero image area. Title and price block. Description. Sticky Add to Cart / quantity stepper floating at the bottom with safe area padding.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Checkout readiness screen with item list and price breakdown.

states.empty: Your cart is empty. Start shopping.

screens.layout: List of selected items with quantity steppers. Bill details (item total, delivery fee, taxes). Sticky 'Proceed to Checkout' primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: HomeServices
screens.purpose: List of available professional services (e.g. plumbing, cleaning).

states.empty: No services available in your area.

screens.layout: Vertical list of service cards with hero images or tinted icons. Price per hour/visit, and 'Book' CTA.

screens.name: RequestAnything
screens.purpose: Custom delivery request form (like picking up a parcel).
screens.layout: Form fields: Pickup Location, Drop Location, Package Description, Size selector chips. Sticky submit button at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Account
screens.layout: Standard list of settings rows (Orders, Addresses, Payment, Help) using feathered icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: BRAND RULE: The brand name is strictly 'Come In'. Do not translate this. Do not imitate competitors like Zomato/Zepto.
Do NOT display fulfilling shop names anywhere in the UI.
COLOR THEME: Mint green (#10B981) as brand primary, sunshine yellow (#FBBF24) as secondary. Do not use blue or purple.
NAVIGATION: Implement 5 bottom tabs: Home, Categories, Search, Cart, Account.

HOME SCREEN: Implement a free-text Location selector at the top (e.g. 'Deliver to: [Input]'). Add a promotional hero banner, Grocery Categories horizontal scroll, Popular Products section, 'Quick Delivery' section, 'Home Services' entry, and 'Request Anything' entry.
COMPONENTS: Use quantity steppers (-/+) directly on product cards for an immediate add-to-cart experience.
PAGES: Build full working screens (using local mock data) for 'Home Services' (listing plumbers, cleaners, etc.) and 'Request Anything' (a form to request custom pickup/drop).
LAYOUT: Apply generous spacing and single-column or 2-col grids. Avoid full-width buttons floating randomly; make primary CTAs sticky at the bottom.
HAPTICS: Add haptic feedback to all quantity steppers (-/+) and primary action buttons (Add to cart, Checkout).
